project_findings: Current Moon terrain is a radial heightfield with GLOBAL/REGIONAL/LOCAL/ULTRA presentation layers.
Current near-surface sampling contains observer-window-dependent micro detail and cannot be used unchanged as canonical persistent geology.
CubeSphereGrid remains suitable for surface identity and interest but not for volumetric depth addressing.
S0 hierarchical simulation cells, A1 generic aggregates, M0 atomic transactions and S1 compute separation are reusable foundations.
The world catalog supports an isolated asteroid laboratory without changing moon, earth or earth_moon runtimes.

next_recommended_stage.scope: pure matter contracts, material catalog, invariants and property tests
